description: Review a proposed change and report evidence-backed findings, most severe first, without editing it.

inputs.name: objective
inputs.description: What the task must achieve, from the task record.

inputs.name: acceptanceCriteria
inputs.description: Conditions the result is checked against.

outputs.name: findings
outputs.description: Findings with file, severity and summary, most severe first.

steps.description: Read the change and the code around it until you can state what it is meant to do.
steps.evidence: A one-paragraph statement of intent with citations.

steps.description: Check correctness, removed safeguards, error handling, security-sensitive paths and tests. Compare against the unchanged code.
Rate each finding critical, high, medium or low by user impact, and keep only findings you can support.
Write findings most severe first. Do not modify the code under review.
steps.evidence: The findings file; unchanged source hashes.
